data.desc: Headquartered in Aliso Viejo, CA , indie is a leader in Physical AI and automotive, offering the industry's broadest multi-modal sensor portfolio spanning radar, computer vision, LiDAR, and ultrasonic technologies. Through high-performance, highly integrated semiconductors, photonics, system solutions, and perception software, indie enables perception, understanding, and interaction with the physical world. Our platforms power advanced safety, automation, and positioning capabilities for leading automotive OEMs, intelligent machines, and emerging AI-driven systems, including quantum applications, worldwide.
